class.name: StandardTrackRenderingBackend
class.brief_description: The core's tracks, drawn as their [TrackData] says.
class.description: Registered with [TrackRenderingServer] as [code]standard[/code], the default backend. A rail track is two rails on a bed of its kind - a ballast prism, a slab, or a street the rails are embedded in - over its formation, banked or cut as its [code]formation_*[/code] say; a road its carriageway and shoulders. Its sleepers - one every [member TrackData.sleeper_spacing], none on a slab or an embedded bed - are MultiMesh chunks drawn within 150 m of the camera, as DoS drew them; a kind of sleeper the look gives no mesh of gets the backend's own. It draws with the renderer's assets, a [TrackRenderingLook] (the project setting [code]reloaded/tracks/look[/code]). Each curve of a switch is drawn as a track of its own; the blades are not drawn.

method.name: track_get_mesh
method.description: The mesh the track is drawn with while it is built; [code]null[/code] otherwise.

method.name: track_get_sleeper_multimeshes
method.description: The [RenderingServer] MultiMeshes of the track's sleepers while it is built, a chunk each.

method.name: track_get_sleeper_transforms
method.description: Where the track's sleepers lie, as they are drawn.
